annotations.title: Check a received invoice before paying it

description:
Check a RECEIVED invoice before booking or paying it (accounts payable). Give the invoice XML (UBL / CII, XRechnung, Peppol, Factur-X XML)
in xml, or a ZUGFeRD / Factur-X / plain PDF as base64 in pdf_base64. Runs EN 16931 / XRechnung validation, the supplier VAT ID in VIES
(and the VIES name against the invoice), the supplier name against EU/UN/OFAC/UK sanctions, arithmetic (lines, VAT, totals, amount due),
IBAN checksum and country, dates, and (my_vat) whether it is addressed to you. With an API key it also checks the account's invoice history:
duplicates and a changed bank account for a known supplier (payment fraud), and saves the result (GET /inbox/invoices).
Returns verdict ok | review | hold (hold = don't pay yet), ok_to_pay, summary and issues in plain English.

my_vat.description: Optional: your own VAT ID, to warn when the invoice is addressed to another company.
my_vat.title: My Vat

pdf_base64.description: Base64 of a received PDF invoice (ZUGFeRD / Factur-X with embedded XML, or a plain PDF).
pdf_base64.title: Pdf Base64

xml.description: Received invoice XML as text (UBL or CII). Give either xml or pdf_base64.
xml.title: Xml
